entries.title: Noto Emoji
entries.author: Google
entries.change: Made smaller (256 px) and saved as WebP. The picture of a pal is the rest frame of its Noto Emoji Animation loop. pictures/LICENSE.txt holds the licence text.

entries.title: Noto Emoji Animation
entries.author: Google
entries.change: Each loop starts at the frame with the marker 'rest', made smaller (256 px), 30 frames per second, and saved as animated AVIF. The still pictures of the pals in pictures/ are these rest frames.
